subject.title: RFC: add local adaptive-refresh replay tooling

question: After fixed-interval validation is repaired, should CodexBar upstream own and support `AdaptiveReplayCLI`, its trace schema, and its package-internal replay architecture?
rationale: Implementation quality cannot decide whether this specialized offline analysis product and its ongoing maintenance cost belong in CodexBar; VISION.md reserves that choice for owner sign-off.

options.title: Accept upstream tooling
options.body: After repairing interval validation, merge the shared-core CLI and maintain its schema, metrics, baselines, and documentation in CodexBar.

options.title: Keep analysis external
options.body: Decline the public executable and keep replay experiments outside the main CodexBar package.

recommendation.title: Accept upstream tooling
recommendation.body: After repairing interval validation, merge the shared-core CLI and maintain its schema, metrics, baselines, and documentation in CodexBar.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and VISION.md make steipete the clearest available owner for accepting or declining the new supported product surface.
